envelope.description: Typebox schemas and the five read tools (status, diff, log, show, blame)

body.title: Typebox schemas and the five read tools (status, diff, log, show, blame)
body.summary: Add schemas.ts with typebox result schemas built from the existing Git*Data interfaces, re-exported as Static types under the same names. For git_status, git_diff, git_log, git_show and git_blame rewrite inputSchema as typebox with identical JSON, declare outputSchema, place option terminators, apply assertSafeArg, and handle the secondary reads: git_show's diff read is a real failure and its numstat read adds data.warnings. Apply the compatibility rejections (git_log limit 0 or 501, git_diff maxBytes 100 and context 51, malformed git_diff exclude or paths, git_diff path plus paths keeps its legacy failure, git_show maxBytes stays clamped).
acceptanceChecks: Each of the five tools' typebox input schema serialises to the same JSON as the schema it replaced
Each of the five returns data that passes its outputSchema for a real temporary repository
git_show with a failing diff read fails the call; a failing numstat read succeeds with data.warnings
The documented compatibility inputs are rejected by the executor and the legacy ones still behave as before

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-tools-integration.test.ts: every git read tool's result fits its declared outputSchema
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: a failing git_show diff read is a failure and a failing numstat read is a warning

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: git_log limit 0 and 501, git_diff maxBytes 100 and git_diff context 51 are rejected, git_show maxBytes 100 is clamped, and the schemas are unchanged
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: git_diff exclude and git_stage empty paths fail with the executor's message through executeTool and with the legacy text directly
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: every typebox input schema serialises to the same JSON as the schema it replaced
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-approval.test.ts: a dash-prefixed path after '--' is accepted and a dash-prefixed ref is rejected
